# PDF.js

The offline page renderer, worker, character maps, fonts, color profile and image codecs come from Mozilla's [PDF.js 6.5.438 release](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.5.438), distributed through the official [pdfjs-dist npm package](https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.5.438.tgz). The distribution license and the notices for its bundled resources are included alongside those files.
